entries.title: DRAFT: Affine normalization of a Poincare target
entries.statement: DRAFT: independent mathematical review pending; no novelty claim. If every full-dimensional isotropic log-concave probability law nu on R^n satisfies Var_nu(g) <= C integral |grad g|^2 dnu for admissible locally Lipschitz g, then every full-dimensional log-concave law mu with covariance Sigma satisfies Var_mu(f) <= C integral grad f^T Sigma grad f dmu for locally Lipschitz f with finite variance and covariance-weighted energy. Conversely, take Sigma=I.
assumptions: locally Lipschitz f with finite variance and covariance-weighted Dirichlet energy

entries.title: DRAFT: Two-block variance criterion requires maximal correlation
entries.statement: DRAFT: independent mathematical review pending; no novelty claim. If the maximal correlation between centered U-measurable and V-measurable L2 functions is at most rho<1, Var(f(U,V)) <= [E Var(f|U)+E Var(f|V)]/(1-rho). If conditional Euclidean-block Poincare constants are bounded by M_U,M_V a.e., C_P(U,V)<=max(M_U,M_V)/(1-rho).
assumptions: maximal correlation bound for all centered functions, not only linear correlations
conditional Poincare and slicing hypotheses for the Euclidean-gradient conclusion
M_U bounds U conditional on V; M_V bounds V conditional on U

entries.title: DRAFT: Isotropic simplex fibers have large conditional constants
entries.statement: DRAFT: independent mathematical review pending; no novelty claim. For every n>=2 there is an isotropic log-concave law on R^n and a unit direction e such that ess sup_Y Var(<e,X>|Y)=(n+1)(n+2)/6 and ess sup_Y C_P(law(<e,X>|Y))=2(n+1)(n+2)/pi^2, where Y is the perpendicular projection of X.
assumptions: uniform law on the explicitly normalized regular simplex
direction parallel to a simplex edge

entries.title: DRAFT: Averaging conditional Poincare constants fails
entries.statement: DRAFT: independent mathematical review pending; no novelty claim. In the isotropic simplex of L2, E C_P(law(<e,X>|Y))=12/pi^2 for every n>=2, but the best B such that E Var(f(X)|Y)<=B E|partial_e f(X)|^2 for all admissible f equals 2(n+1)(n+2)/pi^2. Hence replacing a random slice constant by its mean is invalid.
assumptions: same simplex and axis as L2
locally Lipschitz functions with finite full Euclidean Dirichlet energy

entries.title: DRAFT: Isotropy does not remove nonlinear block dependence
entries.statement: DRAFT: independent mathematical review pending; no novelty claim. In the simplex of L2, the edge coordinate T and its perpendicular projection Y have zero linear cross-covariance but maximal correlation at least sqrt((N-2)(7N+9)/[3(N-1)(5N+6)]), N=n+1>=3; the lower bound tends to sqrt(7/15).
assumptions: same isotropic regular simplex and edge direction as L2
maximal correlation is over all centered square-integrable functions of the separate blocks

entries.title: P0017 source status as of 10 October 2026
entries.statement: The September 2026 campaign label attempted_unsolved for P0017 does not certify current openness. As of 10 October 2026, primary preprints arXiv:2610.05474v1 (Bizeul, Klartag, Lehec), arXiv:2610.01447v2 (Song, Zhang), and arXiv:2610.07728 (Balasubramanian, Kasiviswanathan) claim a universal Poincare constant for isotropic log-concave measures. This campaign worker checked the exact theorem statements of the first two, not their complete proofs. Current openness is UNKNOWN for this packet; neither a new proof nor independent validation of those papers is asserted.
assumptions: source verification is separate from mathematical proof audit

relations.rationale: The averaged-constant obstruction uses exactly the isotropic simplex and its edge conditional interval from L2.
The nonlinear-correlation calculation uses the same T,Y split and the conditional uniform interval from L2.
The existing P0017 card explicitly says current status unverified and records 2026-09-07; this dated annotation supplies subsequently accessed primary publication claims without declaring a theorem.
The conditional-variance criterion supplies an additional-hypothesis route to the P0017 Poincare target, with missing uniform dependence and slice hypotheses stated.
Both are bounded-scope P0017 attempt records: the old card treats the Gaussian/Hermite case; this draft treats a conditional-fiber obstruction and does not prove general KLS.
